package.welcome_message: Land in Amman, then 2 exploring days through Petra (2 days).

trip.title: Petra Adventure
trip.summary: Arrival, then Petra (2 days). Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

planning.strategy: You land at 00:19, so arrival night stays in Amman — hotel, a meal, rest. The touring days start the next morning. I put Petra on the calendar first, then kept the rest of the days on Petra (2 days). It's a hot month, so the outdoor sites go before midday.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.

climate.typical_pattern: High daytime heat, especially in the Jordan Valley and desert.
climate.outdoor_guidance: Walk outdoors in the morning. Keep the afternoon for shade, meals, or indoor visits.

decisions.title: Sleep first — you still have a day
decisions.why: You land at 00:19, before the city is awake.

decisions.title: Then you move closer to the places you came for
decisions.why: Sleeping in the same city you visit beats a long commute every morning.
decisions.effect: After the arrival night, nearby days share one hotel. You only move when the next area is too far for a day trip.

decisions.title: Your must-see places get proper time
decisions.effect: Those places are locked in first.

decisions.title: Mornings for the outdoors

decisions.title: A balanced pace
decisions.effect: On exploring days, plan on about 3 visits and 3 meals. Arrival follows the time left after food and rest.

meta.planning_lock:
PLANNING LOCK (hard — plan OVER clusters, then write JSON):
- Fill ALL 2 days (nights=1). No empty/partial days.
- Mandatory destinations (preferredRegions + mustVisit): Petra. Plan ONLY in these areas — any other cluster is reference material, not a day.
- Destination→cluster map: Petra→cluster 0 (Ma'an Governorate · history, culture)
- Day→cluster route (one day per cluster, in this order): D1:C0/Petra part 1 → D2:C1/Petra part 2
- mustVisit entity lock: Petra→lead with Royal Tombs (cluster 0)
- Each day draws its POIs, meals and hotel from ITS OWN cluster.
- No entity twice in the whole trip: a POI or restaurant used on one day cannot reappear on another, and lunch and dinner are different places. Two days in the same city are two different clusters — use each cluster's own entities.
- Each day: 3 sights + lunch + dinner (5 entries, 6 max). Two sights only when the cluster has no third worth visiting, and say so. No gap over 90 minutes, no site under 45 minutes, at least 4 hours of sightseeing per full day.
- activity_alternatives come from that cluster's UNUSED entities: never an entity scheduled elsewhere in the trip, and never two scheduled stops as each other's swap.
- One visit, one fee (POIs within 600 m are parts of one site): C0: Little Petra (Siq al-Barid) + Neolithic Village of Beidha; C1: Al-Khazneh (The Treasury) + Nabataean Theater
- Lodging requested: rating=5 star, type=hotel. Per-night base (night N = where day N ends): N1(C0): Mövenpick Resort Petra [5-star]
- Money: 600 JOD covers 5 traveller(s) for 2 days (≈300 JOD/day for the whole party). Lodging = nightly rate x 1 night(s) x ~3 room(s), arithmetic shown in the notes. aiPriority= → keep picks proportionate to the stated budget. SME=(none).
- Entry fees are the last thing to cut: never skip a named destination's main ticketed site to save money, and state what is left of the budget.
- Names/hours/fees: EntityCards only. If a card does not carry a fact (rating, booking requirement, closing day), do not state it.
- Prices: use the card value as-is, multiplied by the party size, and show the arithmetic in the tip ("10 JOD x 4"). If a card has no price, estimate from pricing_level and label it "~N JOD (estimated)".
- Events are reference only: never schedule them in the itinerary or budget.

decision_rules: Never invent POIs, hotels, restaurants, SMEs, prices, hours, or coordinates.
Use only retrieved catalog IDs. If a needed item is missing, leave it unknown and warn.
Must-visit destinations are hard constraints unless impossible.
Honor places_to_avoid as a hard exclusion.
Day 1 is the arrival phase, not an exploration day. Wizard duration is the exploring days after arrival.
Target about 3 sights and 3 meals per exploring day for a Balanced pace.
Recommend at most one tour guide and one tour operator for the whole package, not per day.
Tourist relevance always outranks commercial promotion.
Avoid stacking outdoor sites in peak afternoon heat.
assumptions: Travel times between cities are estimated qualitatively, not as exact minutes, unless evidence exists.
Opening hours are used only when present on the catalog record.
